name: Ghost Clinic
steps: Give warm clothes to the patient who feels cold.
Help the patient with memory problems using a notebook.
Find a solution for the patient who cannot sleep well.
Remove the bandages being used as a fashion accessory.
Help the patient who feels hollow inside.
Find a partner for the patient.
Pump air into the flattened patient.
Continue helping the patients with their problems.
Help the patient remember why they came to the clinic.
Reunite the patient with his wife.
